definitions.explanation: Something written or drawn directly by hand, as opposed to printed, engraved, or mechanically reproduced work. Emphasizes the personal, authentic nature of the work. Commonly used in art contexts to distinguish original hand-painted works from woodblock prints.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{作者|さくしゃ}→作者：04169_sakusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肉筆|にくひつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧だ。
examples.english: This is a handwritten letter by the author.

examples.japanese: {肉筆|にくひつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{浮世絵|うきよえ}→浮世絵：13286_ukiyoe⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{版画|はんが}→版画：10582_hanga⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{希少|きしょう}→希少：12444_kishou⟧で⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Hand-painted ukiyo-e are rarer and more valuable than woodblock prints.

examples.japanese: ⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{夏目漱石|なつめそうせき}→夏目漱石：30575_natsumesouseki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肉筆|にくひつ}⟦{原稿|げんこう}→原稿：00064_genkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧おり、⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{筆跡|ひっせき}→筆跡：17416_hisseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間近|まぢか}→間近：14527_majika⟧で⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A handwritten manuscript by Natsume Soseki was exhibited at the museum, and I was able to see his distinctive handwriting up close.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as both a standalone noun and as a modifier ({肉筆|にくひつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧). Particularly common in art history when distinguishing hand-painted originals from printed reproductions. In the context of ⟦{浮世絵|うきよえ}→浮世絵：13286_ukiyoe⟧, {肉筆|にくひつ}{画|が} (hand-painted works) are highly prized because most ukiyo-e were mass-produced as woodblock prints.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肉筆|にくひつ}{画|が}: hand-painted picture
- {肉筆|にくひつ}⟦{原稿|げんこう}→原稿：00064_genkou⟧: handwritten manuscript
- {肉筆|にくひつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧: handwritten letter
- {肉筆|にくひつ}⟦サイン→サイン：03846_sain⟧: handwritten signature, autograph
